title: Choices with jumps
description:
Write these with `cmp` and conditional jumps (the numbers are signed):

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `max(a, b)` | the larger |
| `abs_value(x)` | x without its sign (`abs` and `absolute` are reserved words in NASM) |
| `sign(x)` | −1, 0 or 1 |
| `clamp(x, low, high)` | low if x < low, high if x > high, otherwise x |
| `grade(score)` | the character `'A'` for 90 and up, `'B'` for 75 and up, `'C'` for 50 and up, otherwise `'F'` |

Use local labels (`.done`) so each function can reuse the same names.

starter.solution.asm:
max:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

abs_value:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

sign:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

clamp:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

grade:
        mov     eax, 'F'
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
max:
        mov     rax, rdi
        cmp     rdi, rsi
        jge     .done
        mov     rax, rsi
.done:  ret

abs_value:
        mov     rax, rdi
        test    rax, rax
        jns     .done
        neg     rax
.done:  ret

sign:
        xor     eax, eax
        test    rdi, rdi
        jz      .done
        mov     eax, 1
        jg      .done
        mov     rax, -1
.done:  ret

clamp:
        mov     rax, rdi
        cmp     rdi, rsi
        jge     .not_low
        mov     rax, rsi
        ret
.not_low:
        cmp     rdi, rdx
        jle     .done
        mov     rax, rdx
.done:  ret

grade:
        mov     eax, 'A'
        cmp     rdi, 90
        jge     .done
        mov     eax, 'B'
        cmp     rdi, 75
        jge     .done
        mov     eax, 'C'
        cmp     rdi, 50
        jge     .done
        mov     eax, 'F'
.done:  ret

unitTests:
test "max"
    max(3, 9) == 9
    max(9, 3) == 9
    max(-5, -2) == -2
    max(4, 4) == 4
test "abs_value"
    abs_value(-7) == 7
    abs_value(7) == 7
    abs_value(0) == 0
test "sign"
    sign(-40) == -1
    sign(0) == 0
    sign(12) == 1
test "clamp"
    clamp(5, 0, 10) == 5
    clamp(-3, 0, 10) == 0
    clamp(99, 0, 10) == 10
    clamp(10, 0, 10) == 10
test "grade"
    grade(95) == 'A'
    grade(90) == 'A'
    grade(89) == 'B'
    grade(75) == 'B'
    grade(50) == 'C'
    grade(49) == 'F'
    grade(-1) == 'F'
